# Google GenerativeAI .NET SDK

> Unofficial .NET SDK (C#) for Google Gemini (Gemini API / Google AI Studio) and Vertex AI. Version 4.x. Install with
> `dotnet add package Google_GenerativeAI`. Entry points: `new GoogleAi(apiKey)` (Gemini API) or
> `new VertexAI(projectId, region)` (Vertex AI), then `CreateGenerativeModel(GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash)` and
> `GenerateContentAsync` / `StreamContentAsync` / `StartChat`. Targets .NET 6-11, .NET Standard 2.0 and .NET Framework 4.6.2.

Key facts for code generation:

- Use current model constants (`GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Flash`, `GoogleAIModels.Gemini38Live`,
  `GoogleAIModels.GeminiEmbedding`, `VertexAIModels.Gemini.Gemini38Flash`). Constants marked `[Obsolete]` are retired.
- The newest Gemini models on Vertex AI are served from the `global` location; the RAG Engine and some embedding
  models need a regional location such as `us-central1`.
- Get text with the `response.Text()` extension method. Errors are thrown as `GenerativeAI.Exceptions.ApiException`
  (`ErrorCode`, `ErrorStatus`, `ErrorMessage`).
- Function calling needs `Google_GenerativeAI.Tools`; tools run automatically and results are sent with the `user` role.
- Live API (`Google_GenerativeAI.Live`): `MultiModalLiveClient`; Live models require `Modality.AUDIO` responses.
  Message types use the official SDK names (`LiveClientMessage`, `LiveServerMessage`, ...).
- `GenerativeAI.Types.Environment` exists, so write `System.Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable(...)` when
  `using GenerativeAI.Types;` is present.
- Video generation (Veo) is Vertex AI only; Imagen is not available on the Gemini API.

## Docs

- [Full documentation (single file)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/main/llms-full.txt): every wiki page concatenated
- [README](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/blob/main/README.md): overview, packages and quick start
- [Initialization](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Initialization): creating `GoogleAi` / `VertexAI` clients and models
- [Authentication](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Authentication): API keys, ADC, service accounts, OAuth
- [Configuration & Error Handling](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Configuration-and-Error-Handling): environment variables, locations, exceptions
- [Supported Models](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Supported-Models): current model constants and replacements
- [Generate Content](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Generate-Content): requests, generation config, thinking
- [Chat Session](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Chat-Session): multi-turn chat and history
- [Streaming](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Streaming): `StreamContentAsync`
- [Multimodal Features](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Features): images, audio, video, PDF input
- [JSON Mode](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Json-Mode): structured output, `GenerateObjectAsync<T>`
- [Function Calling](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Function-Calling): tools and built-in tools
- [Embeddings](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Embeddings): Gemini API and Vertex AI embeddings
- [Context Caching](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Context-Caching): `CachingClient`

## Gemini APIs

- [Interactions API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Interactions-API): `InteractionsClient`, background runs, continuation
- [Multimodal Live API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Multimodal-Live-API): real-time audio/video, ephemeral tokens, Live Music
- [File Search](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/File-Search): managed RAG stores
- [Batch API](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Batch-API): `BatchClient` for Gemini API and Vertex AI
- [Model Tuning](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Model-Tuning): `TuningClient`
- [Webhooks](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Webhooks): `WebhooksClient`
- [Agent APIs](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Agent-APIs): decisions, voices, agents, environments, triggers, credentials
- [Image Generation](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Image-Generation): Gemini native image models
- [Video Generation](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Video-Generation): Veo on Vertex AI
- [Speech Generation](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Speech-Generation): text-to-speech
- [Files Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Files-Client): upload, register and download files
- [Model Client](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Model-Client): list, get, update and delete models
- [Vertex RAG Engine](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Vertex-RAG-Engine): corpora and retrieval on Vertex AI

## Integrations

- [Microsoft.Extensions.AI](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Microsoft.Extensions.AI-IChatClient-Implementation): `IChatClient`, embeddings, images
- [Model Context Protocol](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/MCP-(Model-Context-Protocol)-Integration): `McpTool` and transports
- [ASP.NET Core / Web](https://github.com/gunpal5/Google_GenerativeAI/wiki/Web-Application-Integration): `AddGenerativeAI` dependency injection
